note: Who reads each MC follow-up bucket (devloop/DECISIONS/2026-10-08-mc-follow-up-audience.md), as operating/goal2_mc_approval.load_bucket_audiences reads it: buckets maps a bucket id (BKT-...) to its source_ref (where the membership was read), its visibility (restricted, shared or unparented, as MC shows the bucket's project) and its members, keyed by every MC member token of a restricted project exactly as MC lists it (a human email, an Entra oid, a directory id or an sp_* service principal), each with oid (the person's Entra object id, recorded only with oid_source, never invented; null until read, and null for a directory id or sp_* token), read_from (where this member was read) and read_at (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). A follow-up quotes a cited source only when the bucket is restricted, every token is a person (email or oid) and every member reads it as employee:<oid>; a shared or unparented bucket (every MC principal reads it, MCP agents included), a bucket listing a directory id or sp_* token, a bucket not listed here, a member with a null oid, or a member read more than BUCKET_AUDIENCE_MAX_AGE ago gives citations only. Empty until a person chooses the follow-up bucket (GOAL2-ACTIONS.md section 8 item 1) and reads its members (later_ask mc-bucket-member-oids).
